notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least ten permanents.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation
